svg.text: expo/expo · React Native framework · 15 merged · 5 open
Community BottomSheet gets a modifiers prop
RNHostView content follows an animated SwiftUI resize
AudioStream reports state at queue time, drops stale buffers
Host content keeps its alignment on an undersized first proposal
AudioRecord released even when stop() throws
Failed start() leaves no input tap behind
Recurrence daysOfTheWeek stored on the documented weekday
BlurView no longer blank inside MaskedView
DateTimePicker no longer squeezes the calendar after input mode
FieldGroup skips empty rows for falsy conditional children
ColorTypeConverter accepts rgb() and rgba() strings
Chart component gets numeric x-axis support
Orphaned pick resolves as canceled, later picks keep working
openBrowserAsync opens the new URL after the process was killed
Compact DatePicker shows the full date after a push
AudioStream stops when AudioRecord.read() returns an error
openBrowserAsync reports a blocked popup instead of success
Every fix ships with a public reproduction app and before/after recordings.
